selection_record.selection: Random within batch; round-robin across batches; cap/2 cells per target per disjoint batch partition; controls maximum 32 per batch.
selection_record.offset_repair: Exclude cells absent from expression fragments; subtract complete missing-cell expression record counts from later global offsets; verify 128 retained cell starts across full axis.

source_record.canonical_gene_mapping: Original gene token IDs mapped to original symbols; duplicate source symbols summed on challenge axis, never dropped because of converted suffixes.
source_record.normalization: Full-source library verified before gene-axis projection; missing genes remain masked.
source_record.scope: Stratified target and control sample across full release batches, not every raw cell.

treatment_views: Exact V52 disjoint raw-row views, retained unchanged; input control expression uses NTC only
baseline: V24 public hold-study implementation; recipient whole study excluded from its source fit; same baseline as V52 held-source comparisons
